One folder per game, named by its platform and ROM checksum: game.sav, states/ and pack.json. Companion packs and the ROM list stay on the device. Games always play from the device\'s own copy, which is copied to the folder after each save, on pause and on quit. Pick an empty folder, or one GBADuo saves are already in.\n\nTo bring in a save from another emulator, put it in this folder (or in a gba / gbc / gb folder inside it) named like the ROM, for example Pokemon Emerald.sav. It is picked up the next time you play that game, if the game has no save in GBADuo yet. The file itself is left as it is.
If a save changed in both places, the newer one is kept and the other is saved next to it as game.sav.conflict-<time>. Nothing is overwritten silently.
Save folder not available: playing from the device\'s copy. Saves are copied there once it\'s back.
Let this pack change the game?

“%1$s” wants to change %2$s's memory when you tap it, for example to equip an item.

A bad change can crash the game or spoil your save. A save state is made first: Load state > Before pack changes takes you back.

Your answer is kept for this pack and game.
Off: packs only read the game
On: each pack asks first, per game

Some companion packs can change a game\'s memory when you tap them, for example to equip an item without opening the menu.\n\nEach pack still asks before its first change in each game, and only works from your taps. A bad change can crash a game or spoil a save.
